Privacy

Your film records stay on your device. We use analytics to understand how the app is used, and collect an email address only if you sign up for Pro updates or contact us.

Film records

Camera names, film rolls, notes, dates and fridge inventory are stored on your device. They are not sent to us or PostHog. You can remove them in the app or by deleting the app.

Usage analytics

When analytics is enabled, the app sends PostHog events when you open the app or add a camera, roll or fridge item. These events do not include the names, notes or other details you enter. PostHog uses an identifier for your app installation and may derive an approximate location from your IP address. We use this information to understand app usage. Our website also sends PostHog the path of each page viewed.

Email updates

If you enter your email address to hear about Next Roll Pro, we send it to Mailchimp to manage those updates. Signing up is optional. You can unsubscribe from the emails or contact us to request removal.

Advertising

Next Roll does not require an account. We do not use this data for advertising tracking or share it with data brokers.

Support and data requests

If you email support, we receive your email address and anything you include in your message. We use it to reply. We keep analytics and support data while needed for those purposes, and your mailing list email until you unsubscribe or request removal. To ask about your data or request deletion, contact privacy@nextroll.app.
